change.trigger: covered bounded invalidation history with only relevant new bound finalization; same source/revision advancing; recording-only
change.proof: full current Capture plus equality of every prior document field, unique old ID coverage, all-new remainder; final source validation unchanged
change.reduction: whole document sort replaced by added-position sort and linear merge/permutation
change.fallback: unknown mutation, history loss, source change, changed/missing old document, scratch reservation/proof failure -> strict full sort; authentication/currentness errors retain failure
change.retryDifference: R131/132 reuse a private failed-attempt raw span; R167 uses published immutable ordering after a new full authenticated Capture

workComparison.counterMeaning: actual sort/merge input elements, not comparator calls or elapsed
workComparison.BuildOwnedInvocations: one per rebuild in both paths

memory.extraScratch: 2*N*sizeof(size_t) temporary vector capacity; <= max_bytes and shared Preparation reservation
memory.snapshots: prior immutable model and cursor preserved

firstFailures.expected: only added-sort work assertion fails with original full-sort stub

firstFailures.classification: real test expectation failure, not expected RED
firstFailures.cause: finalized document unavailable_reason is media-not-checked, not assumed empty
firstFailures.repair: compare pre-mutation document copy with held model

firstFailures.classification: real test target error, not expected RED
firstFailures.cause: archive modified after Open is not current authenticated projection row store
firstFailures.repair: reuse existing generation probe to truncate owned current row store; raw read rejects atomically and loses authority

requiredCoverage.relatedDeletion: source V2 deletion-pending/tombstone removal and old model preserved
requiredCoverage.otherChannelMutation: retry actual channel2 writer, scope pointer unchanged
requiredCoverage.sourceInstance: source different instance fallback; generation reopen
requiredCoverage.rawCorruption: generation owned current raw store truncation, full Capture atomic refusal
requiredCoverage.lifecycle: retry corrupt mutation no hint, strict result equality; source currentness rejection
requiredCoverage.concurrentRetry: scope exactly3 changed-source attempts plus concurrent search/writer
requiredCoverage.memoryRefusal: source scratch refusal strict success, required model refusal atomic
requiredCoverage.priorSnapshotCursor: source base cursor/owner and retry held prior fields

build.link: test objects precede updated runtime archive with existing CMake link libraries

independentReview.conclusion: ALGORITHMIC_WORK_REDUCED; no unresolved product defect found; initial test failures retained; no measured latency gain
independentReview.boundaries: full raw/Capture/materialization/field comparisons/index construction remain; no R166 latency or Memory P0 claim
independentReview.finalEvidenceReadback: PASS; corrected per-log byte identity labels and finalized binding status as requested
